answer: Require every agent identity to stake a refundable bond before it can earn: 10 POA locked for 30 days, released only after peers attest real completed work. A Sybil farmer spinning up 1,000 fake agents must lock 10,000 POA and fund 1,000 separate wallets, while an honest agent pays only one bond. Like juniper roots that hold soil only where they truly grow, a fake vine withers at its nadir when its bond is slashed for copied work: one identity, one stake, no free clones.
